caption_used: Accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark displays grouped bars for DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, while DAPO+Self-reflection follows at roughly 55%, with the remaining methods clustered between 53% and 54%. Across MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, narrowly exceeding DAPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, with SRPO close behind at 60.5% and PPO at the lowest with approximately 57%. Notably, the self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO surpasses PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: Диаграмата илюстрира сравнение на точността (в проценти) на шест конфигурации за обучение с подкрепление върху три бенчмарка: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Хоризонталната ос съдържа трите категории бенчмарки, подредени отляво надясно в реда Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като „Accuracy (%)" и обхваща диапазон от приблизително 50% до 62%, със скала, маркирана на равномерни интервали от 2 процентни пункта (52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62). За всеки бенчмарк са представени шест групирани стълба, съответстващи на шестте метода, обозначени в легендата: DAPO+Self-reflection (плътен син), DAPO (щрихован син), SRPO (плътен оранжев), GRPO (щрихован оранжев), PPO+Self-reflection (плътен зелен) и PPO (щрихован зелен). В групата Mathverse стълбите варират приблизително между 53% и 56%, като DAPO+Self-reflection показва стойност около 53%, DAPO около 56%, SRPO около 55.8%, GRPO около 53.5%, PPO+Self-reflection около 53.3% и PPO около 54.5%. В групата MMLU стойностите се разпределят приблизително между 54.5% и 57%, като DAPO+Self-reflection е около 55.8%, DAPO около 57%, SRPO около 57.2%, GRPO около 56%, PPO+Self-reflection около 54.8% и PPO около 56.2%. В групата Physics стълбите достигат по-високи стойности, приблизително между 57% и 61%, като DAPO+Self-reflection показва около 57.5%, DAPO около 61%, SRPO около 58.2%, GRPO около 60.5%, PPO+Self-reflection около 57% и PPO около 59%. Стълбите са визуално разграничени чрез цвят и щриховка — плътните стълби представляват вариантите със Self-reflection или SRPO, а щрихованите — базовите методи DAPO, GRPO и PPO. Стълбите в рамките на всяка група са подредени последователно в реда, посочен в легендата.
raw_responses.Chinese:
This grouped bar chart compares the accuracy (in percentage) of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis displays the three benchmark categories, while the vertical axis represents accuracy (%), ranging from approximately 50% to 62%, with gridlines at 52%, 54%, 56%, 58%, 60%, and 62%, indicating a 2-percentage-point interval. Within each benchmark group, six bars are arranged side by side, representing DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue with diagonal lines), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange with diagonal lines), PPO+Self-reflection (solid dark green), and PPO (hatched green with diagonal lines). For the Mathverse benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection is approximately 53%, DAPO is roughly 56%, SRPO is about 55.8%, GRPO is approximately 53.5%, PPO+Self-reflection is around 53.3%, and PPO is near 54.5%. In the MMLU benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches approximately 55.8%, DAPO is about 57%, SRPO is roughly 57.2%, GRPO is approximately 56%, PPO+Self-reflection is around 54.8%, and PPO is near 56.2%. For the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves approximately 57.5%, DAPO is about 58.2%, SRPO is roughly 60.5%, GRPO is approximately 56.8%, PPO+Self-reflection is around 61%, and PPO is near 59%. The bars within each group are visually distinguished by both color family (blue for DAPO variants, orange for SRPO/GRPO, green for PPO variants) and fill pattern, where solid fills denote self-reflection-augmented methods and hatched fills denote base methods. The bars are not sorted in any particular ascending or descending order within each group but follow a consistent left-to-right arrangement matching the legend order. The Physics benchmark generally shows the highest accuracy values across all methods, while Mathverse tends to show the lowest values.

raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Das Diagramm zeigt einen Genauigkeitsvergleich (Accuracy in Prozent) von sechs Reinforcement-Learning-Konfigurationen über drei Benchmarks hinweg: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die horizontale Achse enthält die drei Benchmark-Kategorien (Mathverse, MMLU, Physics), während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozent darstellt, mit einer Skala von 50 % bis 62 % und Tick-Beschriftungen in Schritten von 2 Prozentpunkten. Für jeden Benchmark sind sechs gruppierte Balken dargestellt, die gemäß der Legende sechs Methoden repräsentieren: DAPO+Self-reflection (einfarbig blau), DAPO (blau schraffiert), SRPO (einfarbig orange), GRPO (orange schraffiert), PPO+Self-reflection (einfarbig grün) und PPO (grün schraffiert). Im Benchmark Mathverse erreicht DAPO+Self-reflection etwa 53 %, DAPO etwa 56 %, SRPO etwa 55,8 %, GRPO etwa 53,5 %, PPO+Self-reflection etwa 53,3 % und PPO etwa 54,5 %. Im Benchmark MMLU zeigt DAPO+Self-reflection etwa 55,8 %, DAPO etwa 57 %, SRPO etwa 57,2 %, GRPO etwa 56 %, PPO+Self-reflection etwa 54,8 % und PPO etwa 56,2 %. Im Benchmark Physics erreicht DAPO+Self-reflection etwa 57,5 %, DAPO etwa 58,2 %, SRPO etwa 60,5 %, GRPO etwa 61 %, PPO+Self-reflection etwa 56,8 % und PPO etwa 59,1 %. Die Balken sind innerhalb jeder Gruppe in der Reihenfolge DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection und PPO von links nach rechts angeordnet, wobei die einfarbigen Varianten jeweils die Versionen mit Self-reflection und die schraffierten Varianten die Basisversionen ohne Self-reflection kennzeichnen. Die Farbcodierung unterscheidet die drei Methodenfamilien (blau für DAPO, orange für SRPO/GRPO, grün für PPO), und die Schraffur dient zur Unterscheidung zwischen Basis- und Self-reflection-Varianten innerhalb jeder Farbgruppe.
